newsitem.title: TURKEY: Spicy Turkish kebabs kill hungry diner.
newsitem.headline: Spicy Turkish kebabs kill hungry diner.

text.p: A visiting Iranian who wolfed down platefuls of spicy kebabs in one of the Turkish capital's best-known restaurants paid with his life.
Mohammed Faze died on the way to hospital from his hotel where he collapsed on Thursday night with a stomach haemorrhage after eating five "Adana" kebabs, Anatolian news agency said.
Meat kebabs from the southern city of Adana are renowned as Turkey's hottest.
